title: Resolve a quotient from a codepth-three classification

source.citation: Lars Winther Christensen and Oana Veliche, Local rings of embedding codepth 3: a classification algorithm, arXiv:1402.4052

translation.notes: The five homogeneous generators are entered from the paper's Macaulay2 example. Noether certifies its minimal graded resolution and the ranks m=5 and n=2 used by the classification. The multiplicative Tor-algebra invariants p, q, and r and the final class G(2) remain outside this scoped case.
